description.value: Red Tomato Pies is a pizza chain founded in Williams Lake, BC by Jason and Amber Akeson, making this location the birthplace of what has grown to 11 locations across Western Canada. The menu spans specialty meat, chicken, Hawaiian, seafood, and veggie pizzas with extensive customization options, plus sides, salads, pasta, and desserts. It has earned a strong word-of-mouth following and awards recognition for its handcrafted approach to pizza.

address.value: 360D Proctor Street, Williams Lake, BC V2G 4P6

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and confirms Red Tomato Pies as a real, operating pizza chain with 11 Canadian locations, founded in Williams Lake, BC — the Williams Lake location is listed as a contact option on the /contact page, corroborating the OSM record. The website prominently features online ordering ('Order Now') and explicitly describes plant-based pepperoni, vegan-friendly pizzas, and gluten-free crust options. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, water refill) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.
